positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerified
positions.frame: what counts as verification for the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration, and how far does that verification extend?
positions.why: Both expressions assert the same directional claim — that the 88.4 MHz calibration is validated by comparison against the June reference plates — one in prose form (holding across the full observing band) and one in condensed labelled-field form. They read together as the document's single verification claim, restated at two levels of granularity; no tension between them, just repetition for the record.
